context: Sho and Hina prepare for the school sports day.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、スポーツの日、楽しみ、本当に。
lines.en: Sho, I'm really looking forward to sports day!
lines.style: Bright, open attack. Quick-paced childish enthusiasm. Real warmth in the voice, not performed. Slight lilt upward on the name to catch his attention. Genuine eagerness throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah — it's a real challenge, and I'm gonna try my best.
lines.style: Soft, understated six-year-old conviction. Small pause after the dash. Quiet sincerity, not loud. Gentle warmth threading through. Slow enough to hear the real commitment underneath.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 一緒に、走る、本当、嬉しい。
lines.en: Running together makes me so happy.
lines.style: Warm, open-hearted delivery. Bright but not shrill. Emphasis lands gently on 'together.' Real childish delight in the voice. Pace unhurried, letting the warmth settle.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Everyone cheering — that's what really matters.
lines.style: Small, steady voice. Pause before 'that's.' Noticing something important without grandstanding. Soft and sincere. Gentle warmth, not seeking attention. Thoughtful for a six-year-old.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: It's going to be so much fun — I know it.
lines.style: Bright, closing energy. Confident without being loud. Light emphasis on 'know' — absolute certainty only a child can have. Warm, genuine smile audible throughout. Natural trailing-off into the closing warmth.
